title: ajuga chamaepitys subsp. suffrutescens
intro: Ajuga chamaepitys subsp. suffrutescens, commonly known as wild bugle or bugle, is a subspecies of the Ajuga genus of flowering plants. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Ajuga chamaepitys subsp. suffrutescens include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which can help with wound healing and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include expectorant, diuretic, and antispasmodic effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
